tagline: Building intelligent, user-focused software through mathematics, AI, and modern web technologies.
shortBio: I'm a Mathematics final year undergraduate at the University of Sri Jayewardenepura with a passion for artificial intelligence, software engineering, and creating intuitive digital experiences.
longBio: I'm a final year undergraduate specializing in Mathematics at the University of Sri Jayewardenepura with a strong interest in software engineering, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. I enjoy developing web applications, designing user-friendly interfaces, and building practical solutions that solve real-world problems. My experience includes React, Java, Python, WordPress, and Arduino-based IoT projects. I continuously expand my knowledge through personal projects, hackathons, and university activities while striving to create clean, efficient, and impactful software.
careerObjective: Seeking an AI/ML or software engineering internship where I can apply my mathematical background, strengthen my technical skills, and contribute to building innovative, real-world solutions while fulfilling my university internship requirement.
